description: Descending giant fiber escape circuit in adult female Drosophila (BANC v888). DNp01 descends into the thoracic neuromere T2, synapsing onto tergotrochanteral jump motor neurons (TTMn) and peripherally synapsing interneurons (PSI) connected to dorsal longitudinal flight muscle motor neurons (DLM).

provenance.reference: Bates, Phelps, Kim, Yang et al. (Nature 2026)
